scope: Native IL-LLM ledger readback and multi-process append, not host deployment/ToT consensus

baseline.adversarial_probe: 6 independent POSIX processes x 10 real append calls = 60 rows

remedy.transaction: fcntl/msvcrt file lock -> verify predecessor -> single OS append -> fsync -> readback, plus shared-lock verification

caveats: Full-prefix verification on each append is O(n) and may need separately qualified acceleration at large scale.
A privileged actor capable of rewriting the entire ledger can forge a fresh hash chain; independent externally held checkpoints are required.
GitHub Actions unassigned runner failure is a separate blocker from these local passes.
No browser UI end-to-end 100-pass readback: Chromium local navigation blocked by execution environment administrator.
